response.overview: # Translation  Their first meeting in the pantry makes Adam Aiman mistake Shaza Amira for the new 'tea lady', even though the girl's appearance does not match that job at all. With modern 'trendy' Muslim clothing and branded wear, Shaza Amira could be considered a young manager or company director's daughter. But because of his ego in front of a clever and beautiful girl, Adam Aiman deliberately hurts her, even more so when he discovers that the girl is his stepsister. Shaza Amira simply follows her stepbrother's pace, mutually hating and resenting each other. After a long time of getting to know Shaza Amira's personality, Adam Aiman secretly falls in love and dreams of marrying his stepsister. But unlike what Adam Aiman imagined, Shaza Amira still longs for her former lover. Her lips say there is no more love, but her heart still remembers Zafreil. They meet unexpectedly and then the old story is deliberately continued. The conflict caused by a third party is forgotten.
response.title: Hot Chocolate & Tea Lady
